UninstallCommand: $cmd = $null; foreach ($root in 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Vim', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Vim') { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root) { $cmd = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $root).UninstallString; if ($cmd) { break } } }; if (-not $cmd) { Write-Error 'Vim uninstall entry not found.'; exit 1 }; if ($cmd -match '^"([^"]+)"') { $uninstaller = $matches[1] } else { $uninstaller = $cmd.Trim() }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller)) { Write-Error 'Vim uninstaller not found.'; exit 1 }; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList @('/S', '/allusers') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
